crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An oval-shaped rufous patch is visible on the posterior head/neck region, contrasting with the surrounding grey.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and low-contrast transition between the grey crown and the grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of distinct, high-contrast black and white transverse bands on the tail feathers; a prominent red circular feature is located on the right side of the head region.
